question: Calculate the total income from Meat Lovers pizzas priced at $12 and Vegetarian pizzas at $10. Include any extra toppings charged at $1 each. Ensure that canceled orders are filtered out. How much money has Pizza Runner earned in total?
sql:
-- Calculate total income properly
-- Base pizza prices per item: Meatlovers=$12, Vegetarian=$10
-- Extra toppings: $1 each, counted once per order
WITH order_items AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        cco.order_id,
        cco.pizza_id,
        pn.pizza_name,
        PRO.cancellation
    FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders cco
    JOIN pizza_names pn ON cco.pizza_id = pn.pizza_id
    LEFT JOIN pizza_clean_runner_orders PRO ON cco.order_id = PRO.order_id
),
non_cancelled_orders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT order_id
    FROM order_items
    WHERE cancellation IS NULL OR cancellation = ''
),
non_cancelled_items AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        oi.order_id,
        oi.pizza_id,
        oi.pizza_name
    FROM order_items oi
    WHERE oi.order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM non_cancelled_orders)
),
extras_per_order AS (
    SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) as extra_count
    FROM pizza_get_extras
    WHERE order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM non_cancelled_orders)
    GROUP BY order_id
),
base_income AS (
    SELECT SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN pizza_id = 1 THEN 12.0
            WHEN pizza_id = 2 THEN 10.0
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) as total_base
    FROM non_cancelled_items
),
extras_income AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(extra_count), 0) as total_extras
    FROM extras_per_order
)
SELECT 
    bi.total_base,
    ei.total_extras,
    bi.total_base + ei.total_extras as total_income
FROM base_income bi, extras_income ei
